text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My legs feel so light! I'm so pumped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All I ever had were stuffy memories here,
but not
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the momentum left over from
sightseeing,
Mejiro Palmer runs well in
the Hakodate Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's celebrate your awesome run with a
sick
nightscape pic! ☆

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... This pic is lit and all, but... I
feel like it's
missing something, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's definitely missing something!
choice_data_list: Really? I took a great photo, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Get over here, Trainer. Don't just keep

delegating yourself to be the
photographer, you
bore!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she has a point! ♪ Let's get one
with
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Closer... Cloooser... Squeeeeeze in here!
And...
Waheeeeey! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Yeah! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance to my side and see Mejiro
Palmer
beaming.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
After the way I ran today, I'm sure I'll do
great in
the fall...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking about my next goal...

And well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I want to take on the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer seems to have made up
her mind. I
look at her slightly furrowed
eyebrows...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What? But why?
choice_data_list: No, let's not make the Kikuka Sho our goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm not?! Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer still feels obligated to run.
I don't
think she chose this goal with a
positive outlook.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Next year?! Isn't that a little far out? I
feel like it
should be at least a little
sooner...
choice_data_list: As for your target race... let's make it next year.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But Palmster, don't you still have to
figure out
what kinda stuff you wanna do
besides racing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I guess that's true. I did have fun
today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But yeah... I don't really even know how
I feel yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we decide to make her next
goal the
first race of her senior year, the
Nikkei Shinshun
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Mejiro Palmer continues to run, I'm
sure she'll
have her feelings sorted out
by then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All riiight! If my job is to get in touch
with my
feelings this summer, then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna have sooo much fun! Here in
Hokkaido!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
In Hokkaido? You should for sure have
fun, but...
why here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I figure if I'm gonna get a fresh start, I
might as
well do it where I came from.
It's kinda like
getting reborn in my
birthplace, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wanna forget the embarrassment of my

childhood and start having fun again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've really missed out on some
of the
cool things here too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, bet! ♪ Looks like we're coming
back this
summer, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hokkaido in the summer... What should
we do? I
only ever went to training
camps with the rest of
the fam.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've got some stuff to figure out. Like
what kind
of place Hakodate really is...
and what kind of
Umamusume I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to confirm how Mejiro Palmer
really feels
before the Nikkei Shinshun
Hai next year.
